an4.105:1.8: evameva kho bhikkhave cattāro’me ambūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an4.105:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo āmo hoti pakkavaṇṇī?
an4.105:2.2: idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa pāsādikaṃ hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ sammiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ.
an4.105:2.3: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
an4.105:2.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo āmo hoti pakkavaṇṇī.
an4.105:2.5: seyyathāpi taṃ bhikkhave ambaṃ āmaṃ pakkavaṇṇi,
an4.105:3.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo pakko hoti āmavaṇṇī?
an4.105:3.2: idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa na pāsādikaṃ hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ sammiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ.
an4.105:3.3: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an4.105:3.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo pakko hoti āmavaṇṇī.
an4.105:3.5: seyyathāpi taṃ bhikkhave ambaṃ pakkaṃ āmavaṇṇi,
an4.105:4.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo āmo hoti āmavaṇṇī?
an4.105:4.2: idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa na pāsādikaṃ hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ sammiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ.
an4.105:4.3: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
an4.105:4.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo āmo hoti āmavaṇṇī.
an4.105:4.5: seyyathāpi taṃ bhikkhave ambaṃ āmaṃ āmavaṇṇi,
an4.105:5.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo pakko hoti pakkavaṇṇī?
an4.105:5.2: idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa pāsādikaṃ hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ sammiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ.
an4.105:5.3: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an4.105:5.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo pakko hoti pakkavaṇṇī.
an4.105:5.5: seyyathāpi taṃ bhikkhave ambaṃ pakkaṃ pakkavaṇṇi,
an4.105:5.7: ime kho bhikkhave cattāro ambūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasminti.
